query: AMD fiscal year end and fiscal quarter end dates
normalized: amd dates end fiscal quarter year

output.content:
AMD uses a **52- or 53-week fiscal year ending on the last Saturday in December**. [[1]] 

For **FY2025**, the fiscal calendar was: 

| Fiscal period | End date |
|---|---|
| Q1 2025 | March 29, 2025 [[2]]|
| Q2 2025 | June 28, 2025 [[2]]|
| Q3 2025 | September 27, 2025 [[2]]|
| Q4 / FY2025 | December 27, 2025 [[2]]|

Accordingly, AMD’s quarter ends normally fall on the last Saturday of March, June, September, and December, with exact calendar dates shifting slightly each year. [[1]]
